title: Map
description: A map: the main address of the Contacts settings, coordinates of its own with a pin, or the code of Google Maps’ “Embed a map”, which needs no key. It waits for the visitor’s consent to media; before it, the address and a link to the map.

schema.label: Place
schema.help: Google Maps embed: in Google Maps, Share → Embed a map → Copy HTML, and paste it below. No key needed.

schema.label: Map code or link
schema.help: The whole <iframe …> Google gives, or its address alone: https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=… Only the address is kept; a code of another site is refused.

schema.label: Link “Open in Google Maps”
schema.help: Empty: read from the code when it says where the map is — the centre of the map, or the search it shows; else no link.

schema.label: Latitude
schema.help: From −90 to 90: the first of the two numbers a map shows for a place, 51.5074.

schema.label: Address
schema.help: Shown before the map loads, and on the pin of a map of coordinates.

schema.label: Zoom
schema.help: From 1, the whole world, to 19, a building; 15 is a few streets. The code of Google Maps carries its own.

schema.label: Name for screen readers
schema.help: What a screen reader calls the map: “Map of the office”. Empty: the address, else “Map”.

schema.label: Height on a phone
schema.help: In a column narrower than 36em. Same: the height above.
